name: Public HTTP / JSON
description: Build API clients for user-approved HTTPS origins. No accounts or API keys required.
permissions: Request JSON from approved HTTPS origins; URLs/query strings send app data to those services even for GET
Optionally send requests that change remote data (separate approval)
docs: App: import { plugins } from '@morph/plugins'; await plugins.call('public-http', 'request', {url:'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=51.5&longitude=-0.1&current=temperature_2m'}). URLs must match origins approved in the protected Plugins panel. GET is default. POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE need explicit write permission; pass body as JSON. Headers and redirects are deliberately not exposed. Use useEffect plus loading/error state. Never put credentials in URLs/source. Real calls in Preview and agent tool calls each need separate user approval. Runtime results are JSON only, capped at 256 KiB.

request.description: Request JSON from a user-approved HTTPS origin. GET by default; optional writes require a separate grant.
